result.title: ADC-RANet: Improving Resolution Adaptive Neural Networks with Attention, Distillation and Calibration
result.summary: Dynamic neural networks are a class of adaptive models in which the computation assigned to each input sample is determined dynamically, potentially reducing computational cost while maintaining similar performance. For image classification, the Resolution Adaptive Network (RANet) is a strong approach that progressively allocates computational resources across input scales based on sample difficulty. In this work, we introduce RANet with Attention, Distillation and Calibration (ADC-RANet), an enhanced version of RANet that improves performance across all computational budgets. Our approach combines three tightly connected components: bottom-up channel attention, top-down cascaded knowledge distillation, and overconfidence correction using MixUp, in a synergistic design that coordinates both pathways. Experiments on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet datasets show consistent gains while preserving the efficiency of RANet. Our code is available: https://github.com/jefersonseverino/ADC-RANet

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ADC-RANet，在分辨率自适应网络 RANet 上组合自底向上通道注意力、自顶向下级联知识蒸馏与基于 MixUp 的过度自信校正，在 CIFAR-100 和 ImageNet 上于各计算预算下提升图像分类表现。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按样本难度逐级分配分辨率与计算、并校正如置信度，与 LVR 中逐步获取视觉证据和「何时停止」的预算决策可能存在类比线索，但该工作在单图分类、无推理状态，可迁移性需核查。
